name: Folding Paper
description: An unfinished architectural drawing rises along its creases. Follow the folds, hold them in space, then enter the building.

assets.credit: Original hinged conservatory drawing and vector lettering · Tampa Curated

compatibility: Current browsers with WebGL2 and ES modules. An architectural plate and source package remain available without JavaScript.
Scroll over the drawing to scrub; the surrounding page keeps its native scrolling. Slider, Home/End, and arrow keys provide keyboard alternatives.
On touch, scrub with the slider. Hold & orbit enables finger dragging around the actual intermediate structure.
Reduced motion applies each requested position immediately. The renderer rests when settled, paused, hidden, or outside the viewport.
notes: The same panel geometry exists at every position. Creases are actual parent-child pivots; neither surfaces nor linework fade between finished images.

The conservatory is the principal composition: engraved elevations, real window openings, fluted column sections, structural braces, gables, and linked roof planes. Roof hinges inherit the movement of their supporting walls.
The engine and miniature city are alternative demonstrations of the same mechanism. They use their own panels, hinge stages, linework and camera route.
Scroll or scrub to any position. Hold & orbit freezes that fold and lets you examine it from another angle. Half folded offers a useful starting point; Continue folding returns to the sequence.
The building completes before the camera approaches and enters its doorway. Reverse scrolling retraces the same transformation back onto the sheet.
This is an artistic hinge model, not a fabrication-ready fold pattern or a rigid-body collision simulation. Some engraved and unfolded details overlap as they would in a layered working drawing.
reuse: Download the source with your settings and serve example.html over HTTP. The package includes the Three.js browser runtime and its license; no CDN or package install is required for the example.
Use mount from index.js for the instrument, or createFoldingRig from engine.js to render your own panel definitions.
Define local outlines, openings, stroke paths, parent IDs, pivots, fold axes, angles and stage intervals. Call setProgress with a number from 0 to 1; the result is deterministic in either direction.
Read the included guide for hierarchy transforms, annotation linework, camera integration, preset validation and disposal.
